DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 持参された物は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What have you brought with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りた腰の装具です。私に処方された物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用品と本人処方を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a lower-back brace I borrowed from a friend. It was not prescribed for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between a borrowed item and one prescribed for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に使っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜一度使いました。合うかは自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用回数と適合不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used it once last night. I cannot tell myself whether it fits me properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese how many times you used it and that its suitability is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状と使用の経過を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will pass on your symptoms and how you have used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 痛みは三日前からです。使う前からあったことを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 症状が使用前からと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The pain started three days ago. Please explain that it was already there before I used the brace.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the symptoms began before using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の説明もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have information about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示の写真があります。友人の病名を自分の状態として話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 製品表示と他人の病名を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a photograph of its label. I will not describe my friend's diagnosis as though it were my own condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the product label and someone else's diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The clinical staff will check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使い続ける判断をせず、症状と借用品の使用を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 継続使用を担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide to keep using it myself; I will ask about my symptoms and my use of a borrowed brace.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult the responsible staff in Japanese about continued use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 症状開始、昨夜の使用、本人用でない装具として記録し、診療担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record when the symptoms began, last night's use, and that the brace is not for you, then pass this to the clinical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about finding a job?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、まだ働いています。退職済みとして手続きしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在職中の相談を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I am still employed. Please do not process this as though I have already left my job.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that you are seeking advice while still employed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転職希望の条件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask about your conditions for changing jobs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の勤務後に相談したいです。入社できる日は未定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談時間と入社日未定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like a consultation after my current work hours. I have not decided when I could start a new job.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese your consultation availability and that your starting date is undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 応募を始めるかも相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can also discuss whether to begin applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず求人の条件を比較します。会社へ退職日を約束していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退職日未約束で条件比較を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I will compare the job conditions. I have not promised my company a leaving date.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not agreed on a leaving date and want to compare conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参書類はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職歴のメモです。離職した証明ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職歴メモを離職証明と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: These are notes about my employment history. They are not proof that I have left employment.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish employment-history notes from proof of leaving employment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の目的を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the responsible staff the purpose of your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 在職中の情報収集として、紹介を頼む前に必要な準備を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紹介前の準備を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am gathering information while still employed, and I will ask what preparations are needed before requesting a job referral.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about preparations before a referral.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 在職中の相談として担当へおつなぎします。退職日や入社日を確定した扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the responsible staff for a consultation while still employed. We will not treat either your leaving date or starting date as confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the controls?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右へ動かすと画面では左へ動きます。故障か設定か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 方向操作の異常を未判断で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I move it right, it moves left on the screen. I do not know whether it is a fault or a setting.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the direction-control problem in Japanese without deciding its cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の設定を係員が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A staff member will check the current settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の人の設定かもしれませんが、自分では決めません。まだ本体を開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 設定原因を決めず本体未開放を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It may be the previous user's setting, but I will not decide that myself. I have not opened the unit yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume settings caused it and have not opened the unit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残っている利用回数はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any uses remaining?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二回あります。全部初期化して消す前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残回数を示し初期化を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have two left. I would like to consult you before resetting everything and losing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the remaining uses and hold off resetting in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の操作を止めて、画面を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Stop the current operation and show me the screen, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止めました。試すために追加料金を入れず、この設定画面を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作と追加入金を止め画面を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have stopped. I will show you this settings screen without adding more money to test it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you stopped operating and adding money, and show the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設定変更と回数の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check changes to the settings and how the remaining uses will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから続けます。故障確認のため勝手に配線を抜くことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に継続し無断配線変更をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will continue after hearing the explanation. I will not disconnect wiring myself to check whether it is faulty.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will continue after the explanation and will not alter wiring without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 操作設定と二回の残りを担当へ引き継ぎます。本体には触れず、画面の確認をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass the control settings and two remaining uses to the responsible staff. Please do not touch the unit; wait while the screen is checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。相手は香りが強い物を好みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈り先の香りの好みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The recipient does not like strongly scented things.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the recipient's fragrance preference in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご用途と予算を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the occasion and budget.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引越し祝いで三千円です。花の色より香りを先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途と予算の優先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a housewarming gift, with a budget of three thousand yen. I would like to discuss scent before flower color.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the occasion, budget, and priority in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補の香りを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain the scents of some options.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の希望も確認します。花粉の少なさだけで香りも弱いと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りと花粉を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will also check the recipient's wishes. I will not assume that less pollen means a weaker scent too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check scent and pollen separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切り花と鉢植えの希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you prefer cut flowers or a potted plant?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 世話の負担を聞いていないので、小さい切り花がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 世話の負担から切り花を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not asked how much care they can manage, so I would prefer a small arrangement of cut flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer cut flowers because of the care burden.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この候補なら小さくまとめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can make a small arrangement with these options.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 候補の名前を本人へ伝え、返事後に注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人返答後の注文を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the recipient the names of the options and order after they reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will order after the recipient replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三千円以内の小さな切り花の候補をご案内します。返事まで作成は待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you options for a small cut-flower arrangement within three thousand yen. We will wait to make it until you receive a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送について何を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about sending your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ラベルを買いましたが荷物は家にあります。購入したら取りに来てもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ラベル購入後も荷物が自宅にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought a label, but the parcel is still at home. I thought buying it meant someone would come to collect the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the parcel remains at home after buying the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 集荷の予約も行いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you also book a pickup?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。支払完了のメールだけで、集荷の日時はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払通知のみで集荷未予約と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only have an email confirming payment, with no pickup date or time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only have a payment notice and have not booked collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ラベルを貼った荷物の引渡しはまだなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the labeled parcel has not yet been handed over, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。追跡番号があることを、荷物を預けた証拠とは言いません。このラベルを窓口へ持って来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号と引渡しを区別しラベルの利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I will not say that having a tracking number proves I handed over the parcel. Can I bring this label to the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the tracking number from handing over the parcel and ask about using the label in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使える条件を確認します。購入画面と荷物の大きさが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the conditions for using it. We need the purchase screen and the parcel's dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面を見せます。梱包後の大きさも測ります。条件を確認するまで同じラベルを買い直しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入画面と寸法を示して二重購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the screen. I will also measure the parcel after packing. I will not buy the same label again before checking the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the purchase screen and dimensions in Japanese and hold off making a duplicate purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 集荷を希望されますか。それともご自身で持ち込みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like collection, or will you bring it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は持ち込みたいです。受付できる場所と時間を確認してから荷物を運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持込希望を伝え受付場所と時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I would like to bring it myself. I will confirm where and when it can be accepted before carrying it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer dropping it off and confirm the reception location and hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 購入画面と梱包後の寸法でラベルの条件を確認しましょう。利用可能な受付場所と時間を案内してから、持ち込みをご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-ATSUGI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the label conditions using the purchase screen and dimensions after packing. Please prepare to bring it only after we explain the available drop-off locations and hours.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check how to transport this, correct?

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱の幅は通りますが、上の配管に当たりそうです。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幅と上方障害を分けて報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The box fits through in width, but it looks as though it will hit the pipes overhead.
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the width and overhead obstacle separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだその通路へ入りましたか。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already entered that passage?

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、手前で止めました。横に倒す指示も受けていません。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未進入で姿勢変更未指示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I stopped before it. I have not received instructions to turn the box onto its side either.
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not entered and have no instruction to change its orientation.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の高さと向きの表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the parcel height and orientation markings.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 高さは一メートル半、上向きの表示があります。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 高さと向き表示を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is one and a half meters high and has an upright orientation mark.
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the height and orientation marking in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 経路と方法を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible staff will check the route and method.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を変えず、別通路の高さも確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別経路の高さ確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not change the markings, and I would like the height of another passage checked too.
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the clearance height of another route to be checked.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周囲の人へ待機を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the people nearby to stand by.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台車を止めた場所を伝え、通路を空けて指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止位置を共有し待機する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them where I stopped the trolley, keep the passage clear, and wait for instructions.
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the stopping position and wait in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 高さと向きの条件で経路を確認します。箱を倒さず指定位置に保持してください。
DLG-SC-KNG-EBINA-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the route against the height and orientation requirements. Keep the box upright in the designated position rather than turning it on its side.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換えのお手伝いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like help with a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内の早い便は遠いホームです。走らず次を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 走らず次便を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The earlier service shown in the guidance uses a distant platform. I would rather take the next service without running.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer the next service rather than running.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着したい時刻はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a time you need to arrive by?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十一時です。今の便に乗れなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着期限を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Eleven o'clock. It is all right if I miss the current service.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your required arrival time in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次便の到着と乗換えを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the next service's arrival and transfers.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発車だけでなく、途中でまた乗り換えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着と乗換回数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to ask not just about departure but also whether I will need another transfer along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about arrival time and the number of transfers in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は直通で十時半の到着です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next one is direct and arrives at ten thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら次便にします。同行者も歩くのが遅いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の負担から直通便を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will take the next service. My companion also walks slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the direct service in Japanese considering your companion's burden.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じホームでお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can wait on this same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。急いで別ホームへは行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別ホームへ急がず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not hurry to another platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait rather than rush to another platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次の直通便をここでお待ちください。行先表示も乗車前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here for the next direct service. Also check the destination display before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 丈直しをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like an alteration to the length?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右袖だけ短くしたいです。左はこのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片側のみの丈直しを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like only the right sleeve shortened. Please leave the left as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request an alteration to only one side in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 着た状態で希望位置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your preferred position while you are wearing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。平らに置いて左右同じ長さにする希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着用位置と左右同寸を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I do not want both sides made the same length while the garment is laid flat.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the worn position from identical left and right measurements in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 印を付ける位置を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at where we will mark it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右はこちらです。時計を着けた時にも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時計着用で位置確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here for the right sleeve. I would also like to check it while wearing my watch.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the position with your watch on in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 費用と受取時期を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the cost and collection time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切る前に料金を聞き、左右の指定を記録で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 加工前に費用と記録を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before cutting, I would like to hear the price and see a written record of the right-and-left instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the cost and written instructions before the alteration in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右袖だけの記録はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the record specifying only the right sleeve.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。この条件と料金でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片側条件に同意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked it. Please proceed with these conditions and this price.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the one-sided conditions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 右袖のみの調整で受け付けます。左袖は変更せず、案内した日にお受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it for adjustment of only the right sleeve. We will leave the left sleeve unchanged; please collect it on the day explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何名様のご注文ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people are you ordering for?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大人二人と子ども一人です。子どもは私の料理から分ける予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもへの取り分けを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two adults and one child. I plan to share some of my food with the child.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will share food with the child.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料の制限や味の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there ingredient restrictions or flavor preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食材の制限はありませんが、辛いソースは別にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 制限なしとソース別希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are no ingredient restrictions, but could the spicy sauce be served separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that there are no restrictions and request sauce on the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別添えが可能か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check whether serving it separately is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: できなければ、辛くない料理を選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不可時の料理変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it is not, I will choose a different dish that is not spicy.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will change dishes if it is not possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この料理はソースを別にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this dish, we can serve the sauce separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では一皿を選びます。子ども用の取り皿もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一皿と取り皿を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will choose one plate. Please also bring a small plate for the child.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify one dish and a sharing plate in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲み物はそれぞれ注文しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will each person order a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大人二杯です。料理の取り分けで飲料数は増やしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲料数を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two drinks for the adults. Sharing the food does not mean increasing the number of drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the number of drinks in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ソース別の一皿と大人の飲み物二杯、取り皿一枚でお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your order as one dish with sauce on the side, two adult drinks, and one small sharing plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a tool?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一度だけ使いたいです。販売品を買わず借りる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回用途で貸出を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to use it once. Is there a way to rent it rather than buy an item for sale?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about borrowing for a one-time use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出の対象を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check which items are available for hire.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この売場の商品を、そのまま貸出品とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売品と貸出品を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not treat an item on this sales display as a rental item just as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish sale and rental items in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木の棚を固定します。壁の素材は先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的と素材未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will secure a wooden shelf. I will check the wall material first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the purpose and that the material is not yet confirmed in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用途と操作条件を担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can discuss the purpose and operating requirements with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 経験がないので、説明なしに使えるとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未経験で説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have no experience, so I will not assume I can use it without an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are inexperienced and request an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貸出条件と代案を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain rental conditions and alternatives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 費用と返却日を聞いてから、借りるか別の方法にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件後の選択を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the cost and return date, I will decide whether to rent it or use another method.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to choose after hearing the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 販売品は棚へ戻します。用途、操作、料金と返却の相談を貸出担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will return the item for sale to the shelf. I will pass your questions about the purpose, operation, charges, and return to the rental staff.
